title: Second Largest Distinct Element
description: Given `N` and `N` integers, find the second-largest **distinct** element in the array. If no second-largest distinct element exists (e.g., all elements are equal or `N < 2`), print `-1`.
instructions: Read `N` and the array of `N` integers.
Find the second-largest distinct value in a single pass `O(N)` or by deduplicating.
Print `-1` if fewer than 2 distinct values exist.
hints: When `x > first`: `second = first; first = x;`. When `x < first` and `x > second`: `second = x;`.
